raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 28 txn_ids delivered twice in the same batch, as record_version 1 and record_version 2 with different amounts. 27 of them are POSTED, so silver_transactions keeps both copies, which duplicates keys and double-counts amounts in every gold table. The record_version column marks the later row as the corrected version, so silver should keep only the highest record_version per txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
